targets.summary: Version handling assumes the patch version is always 0 (TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_0); it needs to support non-zero patch versions.
targets.adoption_evidence: Before: `major, minor = required_version` / `required_macro = f"TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_0"`. Merged: `major, minor, patch = required_version` / `required_macro = f"TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_{patch}"`. The patch is no longer hardcoded to 0. The version tuple types were also widened to tuple[int, int, int] throughout the file.
targets.stage3_reason: The linter unpacks `major, minor = required_version` and hardcodes `f"TORCH_VERSION_{major}_{minor}_0"`, so any shim gated on a non-zero patch version gets the wrong required macro and the wrong comparison. The merged code moved to 3-tuples and uses `{patch}` in both macro strings. A reviewer could spot the hardcoded `_0` straight from the code.
